actual_router_fit_on_12N_probe.conclusion: A generic factorized GRU cannot transfer the reflected direction on this low-competence behavior distribution. Two development-only equivariant-head diagnostics also remained below 1% option accuracy and were not adopted into the generic confirmed V10 router implementation.

decision: Do not open selection or confirmation and do not freeze the servo mechanism from this snapshot. Finish the preregistered official-style nominal PPO training, then repeat a small direction-identifiability probe using the competent frozen controller before choosing between the original impulse and bounded servo.
